title: Connect to OpenVPN via NetworkManager
summary: Import an OpenVPN configuration file (.ovpn) into NetworkManager and connect to the VPN. This is the easiest way to use a third-party VPN service on a desktop.
prerequisites: You have an .ovpn configuration file from your VPN provider.

steps.explain: Import the .ovpn configuration file into NetworkManager. Replace <CONFIG_FILE> with the path to your .ovpn file.
steps.cmd: nmcli connection import type openvpn file <CONFIG_FILE>

steps.explain: Activate the newly imported VPN connection. Replace <CONNECTION_NAME> with the name shown in the previous step's output (usually the filename without extension).

placeholders.name: CONNECTION_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the imported VPN connection
